entities.name: Savaea
entities.description: Forest on the southern part of Oneah, home of the Savaen elves.

entities.name: Savaen elves
entities.description: Leaderless elf magicians able to disenchant.

entities.name: Emperor Oak
entities.description: Huge ancient tree worshipped in Savaea.

entities.name: Elder Leaf
entities.description: Elf who led Kruuna to the Emperor Oak and was killed.

entities.name: Kruuna
entities.description: Goblin Chieftess led to the Emperor Oak.

events.summary: After the Fall of Oneah, human refugees flee through Savaea and are allowed to pass.
events.quote: They were permitted to pass through without incident.

events.summary: The Elder Leaf is killed after bringing Kruuna to the Emperor Oak, and the elves turn on the goblins.
events.quote: the elves of Savaea started pitying the goblins first, then filling them with arrows

relations.note: The Elder Leaf was killed after leading her to the oak.
relations.quote: After the Elder Leaf led the Goblin Chieftess Kruuna to the Emperor Oak
